1: """Starter module for the locked Toolformer loss-filter task."""
2: 
3: from __future__ import annotations
4: 
5: import numpy as np
6: 
7: 
8: def filter_api_calls(
9:     logp_with_result: np.ndarray,
10:     logp_call_only: np.ndarray,
11:     logp_no_call: np.ndarray,
12:     tau_filter: float,
13: ) -> tuple[np.ndarray, np.ndarray]:
14:     """Return an ordered keep mask and one finite margin per proposed call."""
15: 
16:     # Validate tau_filter
17:     if isinstance(tau_filter, bool):
18:         raise ValueError("tau_filter must not be a boolean")
19:     if not isinstance(tau_filter, (int, float, np.floating)):
20:         raise ValueError("tau_filter must be a numeric type")
21:     if tau_filter < 0 or not np.isfinite(tau_filter):
22:         raise ValueError("tau_filter must be nonnegative and finite")
23: 
24:     # Validate input arrays
25:     for arr, name in [
26:         (logp_with_result, "logp_with_result"),
27:         (logp_call_only, "logp_call_only"),
28:         (logp_no_call, "logp_no_call"),
29:     ]:
30:         if not isinstance(arr, np.ndarray):
31:             raise ValueError(f"{name} must be a numpy array")
32:         if arr.ndim != 2:
33:             raise ValueError(f"{name} must be a 2D matrix")
34:         if not np.issubdtype(arr.dtype, np.floating):
35:             raise ValueError(f"{name} must have floating dtype")
36:         if not np.isfinite(arr).all():
37:             raise ValueError(f"{name} contains non-finite values")
38:         if np.any(arr > 0):
39:             raise ValueError(f"{name} contains positive values")
40:         if arr.shape[1] == 0:
41:             raise ValueError(f"{name} must have at least one column")
42: 
43:     if not (logp_with_result.shape == logp_call_only.shape == logp_no_call.shape):
44:         raise ValueError("All three matrices must have the same shape")
45: 
46:     n_candidates, future_horizon = logp_with_result.shape
47: 
48:     # Compute normalized decreasing weights
49:     t = np.arange(future_horizon, dtype=float)
50:     raw_weights = np.maximum(0.0, 1.0 - 0.2 * t)
51:     total_raw = np.sum(raw_weights)
52:     if total_raw == 0.0:
53:         raise ValueError("All raw weights are zero; future horizon may be too large?")
54:     weights = raw_weights / total_raw
55: 
56:     # Weighted future-token loss (negative weighted log probability)
57:     L_plus = -np.dot(logp_with_result, weights)
58:     L_call = -np.dot(logp_call_only, weights)
59:     L_empty = -np.dot(logp_no_call, weights)
60: 
61:     L_minus = np.minimum(L_empty, L_call)
62:     margin = L_minus - L_plus
63:     keep = margin >= tau_filter
64: 
65:     return keep, margin.astype(np.float64)
